name: org.agenticpress/mcp
title: AgenticPress Breakage Shield
description: Free zero-auth MCP breakage shield for AI model deprecations, cloud quotas, runtime EOL & AI laws.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST before writing code, configs, or advice that hardcodes an AI model ID, runtime version, cloud quota, or regulatory deadline. Returns a compact primary-sourced verdict (ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, SUNSET, CHANGED, UNKNOWN), prescriptive action (SAFE_TO_USE, MIGRATE_SOON, DO_NOT_USE, ENFORCE_LIMIT, UNTRACKED), direct 1-sentence summary, cutoff_date, days_remaining, official replacement, and matched_host when a third-party host (e.g. AWS Bedrock) applies. Covered domains (27 primary sources): AI model catalogs & deprecations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock); runtimes/OS/CI (Node.js, Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Ubuntu, Alpine, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions runners); cloud quotas & APIs (Google Cloud Run, Firestore, Cloudflare Workers/KV/D1/R2, AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Stripe API, MCP spec); AI compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). Skip calling for uncovered stacks (e.g., React, Next.js, Tailwind, Ruby, Rust crates).

target.description: Model ID, runtime version, cloud quota, or compliance target (e.g., "claude-3.5-sonnet", "gpt-5", "gemini-4-hydrogen", "node 22", "python 3.12", "vercel body size")

provider.description: Optional provider scope to disambiguate multi-cloud models (e.g., "anthropic", "aws-bedrock", "openai", "google", "cloudflare")

include_evidence.description: Return full claim objects in evidence (default false for minimal token usage)

tools.name: check_batch
tools.description: CALL THIS when auditing a repository (Dockerfile, package.json, pyproject.toml, GitHub Actions, wrangler.toml, or AI SDK model IDs) to verify 2–25 targets in ONE single low-token round-trip. Returns action counts (DO_NOT_USE, MIGRATE_SOON, ENFORCE_LIMIT, SAFE_TO_USE, UNTRACKED) and compact verdicts for every target. Covered domains (27 primary sources): AI model catalogs & deprecations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock); runtimes/OS/CI (Node.js, Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Ubuntu, Alpine, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions runners); cloud quotas & APIs (Google Cloud Run, Firestore, Cloudflare Workers/KV/D1/R2, AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Stripe API, MCP spec); AI compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). Skip calling for uncovered stacks (e.g., React, Next.js, Tailwind, Ruby, Rust crates).

targets.description: List of 1–25 model IDs, runtime/OS versions, or cloud limits to verify in parallel (e.g., ["node 22", "python 3.12", "gpt-5", "ubuntu 22.04", "vercel body size"])

provider.description: Optional provider scope applied across the batch

tools.name: get_recommended
tools.description: CALL THIS when starting a new project or choosing a current active AI model ID or supported LTS runtime version without guessing stale names. Strictly scoped to core AI providers (openai, anthropic, gemini) and active LTS runtimes (node, python, go, postgresql, ubuntu, alpine). Returns verified canonical active IDs/versions by role (flagship, balanced_coding, fast_low_cost, reasoning, embedding, active_lts), last_verified_at timestamps, and primary source URLs.

provider.description: Optional AI provider filter ("openai", "anthropic", or "gemini"). Omit for all tracked providers; cannot be combined with category="runtime".

category.description: Optional category filter ("ai_models" or "runtime"). Omit to return both current AI models and active LTS runtimes.

tools.name: get_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Call this when auditing a codebase, planning migrations, upgrading runtimes, or checking upcoming breaking changes, model shutdowns, cloud quota shifts, and enforceable compliance deadlines within a time window. Defaults to compact mode and limit=15 to preserve context budget. Covered domains (27 primary sources): AI model catalogs & deprecations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock); runtimes/OS/CI (Node.js, Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Ubuntu, Alpine, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions runners); cloud quotas & APIs (Google Cloud Run, Firestore, Cloudflare Workers/KV/D1/R2, AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Stripe API, MCP spec); AI compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). Skip calling for uncovered stacks (e.g., React, Next.js, Tailwind, Ruby, Rust crates).

days.description: Future lookahead window in days (1–365, default 90)

include_recent_past_days.description: Recent past lookback window in days to catch just-passed cutoffs (0–90, default 14)

category.description: Optional category filter matching impact_type, topic, or entity slug (e.g., "model_deprecation", "runtime_eol", "compliance_deadline", "AI APIs")

limit.description: Maximum number of deadlines to return (1–50, default 15)

compact.description: Return compact token-saving deadline objects (default true)

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: Call this to discover all tracked entity slugs, topics, active claim counts, and last_verified_at timestamps before calling get_entity or when check_status returns UNKNOWN.

topic.description: Optional case-insensitive topic filter (e.g., "AI APIs", "Cloud Infrastructure", "Runtimes", "AI Regulation")

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Use when you need to look up a specific limit, deprecation, quota, or policy across all tracked domains and do not know the exact entity slug. Performs case-insensitive search across verified active, upcoming, and postponed claims (excludes staged and superseded claims). Covered domains (27 primary sources): AI model catalogs & deprecations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock); runtimes/OS/CI (Node.js, Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Ubuntu, Alpine, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions runners); cloud quotas & APIs (Google Cloud Run, Firestore, Cloudflare Workers/KV/D1/R2, AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Stripe API, MCP spec); AI compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). Skip calling for uncovered stacks (e.g., React, Next.js, Tailwind, Ruby, Rust crates).

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for

limit.description: Maximum number of claims to return (default 10, max 25)

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Call when you already know the entity slug (from list_entities or check_status) and want its full verified summary, last_verified_at timestamp, and all current active, upcoming, and postponed claims with primary source URLs.

tools.name: get_entity_history
tools.description: Call when you need to verify whether a deadline was postponed, a quota was raised, or a deprecation date changed over time. Returns the full chronological timeline of active and superseded claims with explicit supersession links and Before/After statements.

tools.name: get_latest_updates
tools.description: Call when checking what changed recently across all tracked APIs, runtimes, quotas, and regulations since a given date or your last training cutoff. Returns the most recently verified current claims (excludes staged and superseded claims).

since_iso_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or timestamp lower bound for created_at

limit.description: Maximum number of claims to return (default 10, max 25)
